title: Complete exact route schema and auth isolation
objective: Make the no-tool choice explicit in every exact route and replace isolated Codex authentication copying with a crash-safe link while preserving the existing fail-closed launch contract.
scope: focused deterministic tests and concise documentation

may: inspect the named repository files with direct source and rg commands
modify the named route, Runner, validation, test, and documentation files
may_not: modify global configuration, global skills, plugins, Herdr, wake transport, siblings, or .opsle authority
invoke another provider, review route, web, MCP, plugin, subagent, or fallback

relevant_context: A no-optional-capability Codex route currently uses empty tool_allowlist and skill_allowlist arrays.
The target schema must additionally record selected_tool as the literal none.
The isolated per-attempt home must contain no credential bytes if Runner is killed before cleanup; a link to the existing auth file is acceptable.
Do not broaden selected capabilities or change route selection, wake, provider, review, or fallback behavior.
expected_deliverable: An explicit selected_tool field plus crash-safe isolated authentication linking, with fail-closed validation and focused tests.
acceptance_criteria: Codex exact routes record selected_tool as none
deterministic exact routes record selected_tool consistently with the authorized command tool
Codex launch rejects a missing or non-none selected_tool for the no-tool execution class
isolated CODEX_HOME contains only an auth.json symbolic link and no copied authentication bytes
